name: brain-engine
description: The code for a second brain: the brain command, the server, the phone app, and the Worker.

scripts.test: f=0; npm --prefix engine test || f=1; npm --prefix web/app test || f=1; npm --prefix web/worker test || f=1; exit $f
scripts.gates: f=0; npm --prefix engine test || f=1; npm --prefix engine run check || f=1; npm run privacy || f=1; for d in web/app web/worker; do npm --prefix $d run typecheck || f=1; done; npm --prefix web/app test || f=1; npm --prefix web/app run lint || f=1; npm --prefix web/app run format:check || f=1; npm --prefix web/app run size || f=1; npm --prefix web/app run build || f=1; npm --prefix web/worker test || f=1; npm --prefix web/worker run lint || f=1; npm --prefix web/worker run size || f=1; exit $f
